monit_daemon_interval.description: The interval in seconds between Monit daemon check cycles.

monit_httpd_port.description: The port number for the Monit HTTP interface.

monit_httpd_address.description: The IP address or hostname for the Monit HTTP interface to bind to or accept connections from.

monit_httpd_allow_user.description: The username required to access the Monit HTTP interface.

monit_httpd_allow_pass.description: The password required to access the Monit HTTP interface.
